work.assumptions: Fixture: the time-diary day is a random day for each respondent; nonresponse is ignorable given the weighting classes.
work.estimand: Fixture: mean minutes worked per person-day, all days of the year.
work.estimator: Fixture: ratio of weighted sums, total weighted minutes over total weight.
work.explicit_weights: Fixture: the final person-day weight, which adjusts the design weight for nonresponse and day of week.
work.implicit_weights: None: a weighted mean gives each person-day its weight and nothing else.
work.randomness: Fixture: repeated sampling of households and the random assignment of a diary day.
work.target_population: Fixture: civilian noninstitutional population 15 and older, person-days of one calendar year.
work.title: Fixture ledger: how much do Americans work?
work.variance_estimator: Fixture: weights only, so the standard error is understated; no uncertainty lesson rests on it.
